name: AnyPS5
description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
one_liner: Automatically converts PlayStation 5 game programs so they can run directly on a Windows or Linux PC, without an emulator.
buyer: Honestly, almost nobody paying. The realistic audience is hobbyist game preservationists and PC-porting tinkerers, not a business buyer.
business_use_cases: A game preservation group uses it to keep PS5-exclusive titles playable on PC hardware after console support ends.
A technical hobbyist streams or writes tutorials about the porting process to build an audience.
A boutique PC-port studio could study its relinking approach as a reference, though shipping ported console games commercially raises serious licensing issues.

money_ideas.idea: Tutorials, Patreon-style support, or YouTube content explaining the porting process to a hobbyist audience.

steal_this: Not really a weekend business idea — this is a hobbyist/legal-grey-area tool. The only honest 'steal' is the relinker technique itself as a learning resource for other porting projects, not a product to sell.
